name: Blood Parasites adds 3 Rage to every Taldaram's Torment tick (#12546)
contract: Taldaram's Torment (802580) generates 582765 Energize Rage s1 (EffectBasePoints 29 + 1 = 30 internal, 3 Rage) per tick.
Blood Parasites 802315 effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 +30 on SpellFamilyFlags[1] 0x80, which is
582765's family flag, so its tooltip 'generates $/10;s1 additional Rage per tick' means 6 Rage (60 internal) per tick.
The tick handler energized a hardcoded 30 and never evaluated 582765, so the talent added nothing (#12546).
Two periodic ticks (3000 ms amplitude) must add exactly 120 internal Rage with the talent, against 60 before the fix.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Taldaram's Torment lands on the enemy
DISCRIMINATING: two ticks add exactly 120 internal Rage (60 per tick)
